docs.summary: Represents a reference to a style state that can be conditionally applied. Provides a fluent API for setting style properties based on element state conditions.
Applies the predefined styles from the given template to the element, but only when this state-driven style is active (the condition is met). Returns this instance for fluent chaining.
Applies the named styles to the element if the current state condition is active.
